decisions.reason: As a large German metal products manufacturer, the firm is likely to retain an industrial sectional door that stayed visible after launch because it fits the core industrial door portfolio, though some rationalisation risk remains if products overlap.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door appears close to the firm's core offering and its insulated specification matches steady industrial demand for energy-efficient building products, so it is more likely to be kept.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door had its own dedicated page after launch, it likely had stronger commercial or strategic importance within the portfolio and is therefore the least likely to be dropped soon.
